runtime/buffer#

The native layer under http/internal/http2_body, http/internal/wire_bytes, io/buffer, io/decorators: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under http/internal/http2_body, http/internal/wire_bytes, io/buffer, io/decorators: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Opaque mutable storage shared by the capability views from io/buffer.
